Translated Journal entries

Excelsior Industries Facility 4F2H Log Entries

- Facility set up has gone well. It appears that we have remained
undetected at this time. All of the equipment has been received.
Production will start soon.

- The initial load of materials for assembly of ‘droids’ has arrived.
Production has begun.

- Several squads of battle golems have been assembled and are staged.
Production continues on schedule, despite several malfunctions of the
assembly equipment. Antony and the technicians have been able to keep
the assembly equipment functioning despite limited parts and supply
runs.

- The mind-loader had malfunctioned and we are unable to activate
further war golems. Star Hill and Gravestone have been notified and a
replacement requested.

- Communication and supplies have been spotty. The campaign in the east
is not going as well as hoped. Facility KD9E remains in communication
with us. We are prepared to execute the western campaign plan. Facility
J38D has come online as well.

- The western campaign has progressed on schedule. Initial successes are
beyond expectations. The illusion magic was the perfect disguise – the
Dwarves didn’t suspect a thing! Kergrin is nearly in our control. The
outer city has largely been taken and cleared of the vermin. Our forces
are assaulting the inner city gates.

- Disturbing news from the front, the vermin found reinforcements
somewhere and have begun to drive back our war golems. They seem to have
found a new weapon that we were not aware of. They are cutting through
our lines much faster than before. The mind-loader has still not
arrived, and we are unable to supply reinforcements.

- Dwarvish forces have reclaimed the outer city. Our war golems have
been driven back and their ranks are heavily thinned with the lack of
resupply.

- Our forces are nearly exhausted and supply routes threatened. I have
decided to collapse the access tunnels to prevent capture of the
facility. I have sent a distress message to Gravestone and Star Hill. I
pray to the Star that reinforcements will come quickly!

- It has been three weeks since I collapsed the tunnels and placed our
remaining war golems into facility defense mode. Nothing has been heard
from headquarters or any other facility. Supplies are dwindling and the
crew is beginning to show signs of stress. Ryland has taken ill and we
have no medicine to treat him. I fear he will pass soon.

- Food has run out, water is limited. Wat and Sully have died. I fear
that this place will become our tomb.

- Daren attacked me, but I defeated him. All hope of rescue is lost.
This will be my last entry. Long may the light of the Star shine.

Sloan Taegan, cleric of the Shining Star
